answers.core: In Vulkan, these textures live on the same GPU and would only need proper barrier synchronization. Unity allows this trivially.
answers.workaround: Running the same calculation on CPU or doing a full copy to the GPU is orders of magnitude worse than just being able to let a compute shader access the same texture

title: RenderingDevice compute shaders should be able to access textures created by ImageTexture or ImageTexture3D
